title: Ajudes a l'estudi de la Universitat de València (UV Study Grants for students on official degree programmes)
legacy_titles: Beques pròpies de la Universitat de València
Beques d'exempció de taxes de la UVEG
Ayudas al estudio de la Universitat de València
program_type: University-administered study grant covering academic tuition fees for students already enrolled on official degree programmes at the university's own centres
funding_type: Tuition fee (academic-fee) coverage only, university-funded; no living allowance
administering_authority: Universitat de València, through the Vicerectorat d'Estudis (Vice-Rectorate for Academic Affairs) and the Servei d'Estudiants (Student Service)
implementing_agency: Servei d'Estudiants de la Universitat de València (instructor of the procedure); decider is the Vicerectorat d'Estudis
programme_action: Strategic Grants Plan of the Universitat de València, 2026 subsidy line with ID 101, 'Ajudes a l'estudi per a l'estudiantat que curse estudis oficials en la Universitat'
description: The Universitat de València (UV) calls, each academic year, its own study grants ('Ajudes a l'estudi') for students already enrolled on official degree programmes at UV's own centres. The grant pays the student's academic tuition fees (taxes acadèmiques) for that academic year, rather than paying a cash allowance: for bachelor's and double-bachelor's students it covers all credits of first and second enrolment, up to the maximums set by UV's Enrolment Regulation. The scheme is explicitly aimed at students with financial need who did not obtain a Ministry (MEC) or Generalitat Valenciana grant, so it applies wider income and asset thresholds than those national calls. For the 2025-2026 cycle the call is funded with EUR 300,000 from UV's own budget (EUR 180,000 earmarked for bachelor's students and EUR 120,000 for official master's students), and the application window ran from 10 April to 11 May 2026.

award_types: Ajuda a l'estudi (study grant): payment of academic tuition fees for the 2025-2026 academic year
programme_structure.award_types_detail: Bachelor's and double-bachelor's students: all credits of first and second enrolment up to the maximums established by UV's Enrolment Regulation. Official master's that enables regulated professions: first and second enrolment credits. Non-enabling official master's: first enrolment credits, capped at the per-credit price in point 2.2 of Annex I of Decree 101/2024 of the Consell. Double master's programmes: all first-enrolment credits. The grant does not cover administrative fees (expedient formation, university card, school insurance) nor special prices arising from credit recognition/adaptation.
programme_structure.renewal_criteria: The scheme is re-called every academic year (calls for 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 are all published on the same UV page); there is no automatic roll-over. A recipient of one cycle must submit a fresh application and satisfy that cycle's income, asset, credit and academic-progress requirements. The call also states that recipients must be up to date with the payment of the 2025-2026 tuition fees.
programme_structure.intake: Single annual call for the following academic year; the 2025-2026 cycle window was 10 April - 11 May 2026, tied by rule (base 9.4) to one month from the day after publication of the extract of the call in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana.

status_note: The 2025-2026 cycle was resolved and published; its application window closed on 11 May 2026, earlier than the research date of 2026-10-03, so this cycle is CLOSED. UV has re-called this scheme every academic year, so the next cycle (2026-2027) is expected in spring 2027, with the window again opening on the day after the DOGV publication of the extract of the call.
verification_type: Official university website (uv.es) plus the official regulatory call (DOGV and UV Official Board).
verification_notes: Read the UV 'Ajudes a l'estudi' page (Valencian and English versions), the UV news item explaining the scheme's coverage, the signed convocatòria PDF (Resolution of 24 March 2026, Annex I bases), the definitive award resolution PDF and its annexes, and the DOGV extract of the call. All quoted rules, amounts, thresholds and dates were taken from those documents. The web-search tool was unavailable during this session, so research was done exclusively by fetching official uv.es and dogv.gva.es URLs directly; nine official-domain fetches were made.
source_last_updated: The UV 'Ajudes a l'estudi' page lists the call for 2025-2026 (resolution of 24 March 2026, applications 10 April - 11 May 2026); the definitive award resolution for the preceding 2024-2025 cycle is dated 17 November 2025.

application_deadline.typical_application_window: Historically late February to late June depending on cycle: 19 February - 18 March 2024 (2023-24); 26 May - 25 June 2025 (2024-25); 10 April - 11 May 2026 (2025-26). The legal rule is one month from the day after publication of the extract of the call in the DOGV.
application_deadline.application_period: 10 April 2026 to 11 May 2026 (2025-2026 cycle, now closed).
application_deadline.official_rule: Base 9.4: 'El termini de presentació de sol·licituds és d'un mes a comptar de l'endemí de la data de publicació de l'extracte de la convocatòria en el Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana.' The DOGV extract was published on 9 April 2026 (DOGV num. 10338), so the window ran 10 April - 11 May 2026.
application_deadline.deadline_warning: The 2025-2026 window closed on 11 May 2026. Because the exact date is set only when the DOGV extract is published, candidates must not rely on a fixed calendar date and should watch the UV grants news page and the DOGV in spring 2027.

programme_duration.official_range: One academic year of academic-fee payment per call (2025-2026 cycle); the funded official bachelor's degree itself is not shorter than 4 years under the Spanish EHEA structure, but the grant covers a single academic year of it.
programme_duration.renewal_note: Re-called annually; renewal requires a new application meeting that cycle's requirements, plus being up to date with the tuition fees of the funded academic year.

funding.scholarship_type: Academic fee (tuition) payment grant, university-funded, means-tested
funding.monthly_amount_note: No monthly stipend or living allowance is paid. The grant pays the student's academic fees directly, so the individual amount equals that student's own tuition bill and is not a fixed published sum.
funding.travel_amount_note: No travel allowance is provided by this call. UV runs a separate 'Bourses de viatge' (travel grants) scheme.
funding.institutional_costs: Total budget of the 2025-2026 call: EUR 300,000 from chapter IV of UV's 2026 budget, budgetary unit 6701600000 'Beques UV matrícula oficial grau i postgrau', of which EUR 180,000 for bachelor's students and EUR 120,000 for official master's students; any remainder in one line may be transferred to the other. Individual amounts observed in the preceding 2024-2025 award annex range up to EUR 2,120.40.
funding.fully_funded_note: Not a fully funded award. It covers academic tuition fees only: no living allowance, travel allowance, installation, insurance or accommodation support, and administrative enrolment fees are excluded. Call it a tuition-waiver grant, not a full ride.

tuition.conditions: Payment of the academic fees for the 2025-2026 academic year. Bachelor's and double-bachelor's: all credits of first and second enrolment up to the maximums in UV's Enrolment Regulation. Excludes administrative enrolment fees and prices arising from recognition/adaptation of studies.

monthly_stipend.note: Not published in official source - the grant pays tuition, not a stipend.

travel_allowance.note: Not part of this call; UV has a separate travel-grant scheme ('Bourses de viatge').

insurance.note: Not published in official source; administrative insurance fees (school insurance) are explicitly outside the grant's scope.

research_allowance.note: Not part of this call; UV has a separate research-collaboration grant scheme.

equipment_allowance.note: Not published in official source (a separate temporary computer-loan scheme exists).

bond.note: No bond or service obligation is published. Repayment can be required where the student fails to meet the requirements, and payment is conditional on being up to date with the 2025-2026 tuition fees.

total_estimated_value.note: Do not compute a per-head 'total value': the individual award equals each student's own tuition bill. The officially published aggregate is EUR 300,000 for the whole call, EUR 180,000 of it for bachelor's students.

coverage: Academic tuition fees (taxes acadèmiques) for one academic year at Universitat de València
Bachelor's and double-bachelor's: all credits of first and second enrolment, up to UV's Enrolment Regulation maximums
Official enabling master's: first and second enrolment credits
Non-enabling official master's: first enrolment credits, capped at the Decree 101/2024 per-credit price
Double master's programmes: all first-enrolment credits
coverage_limitations: Administrative enrolment fees (expedient formation, university card and school insurance) are explicitly excluded from the help.
Special prices arising from credit recognition, adaptation or convalidación are excluded.
No living allowance, travel, installation, accommodation or insurance support is provided.
The grant is incompatible with total exemptions applied to enrolment and with the MEC general scholarship and the Valencian Conselleria university-studies scholarships for the same academic year.
Doctoral students, students on UV's own (títols propis) degrees and students at affiliated (adscrits) centres are excluded.
The individual amount is not fixed: it equals the student's own tuition bill, so it varies by degree, credits and enrolment type.
Exact benefit structure may differ in future cycles; all amounts and thresholds quoted here are those of the 2025-2026 call.
eligible_applicants: Students enrolled in the 2025-2026 academic year on official degree programmes (bachelor's/Grau or double bachelor's) at Universitat de València's own centres
Students who are Spanish nationals or nationals of an EU member state
Non-EU (third-country) students who can prove administrative residence in Spain - applicants in a 'estada' (stay) situation are excluded
Students registered (empadronats) in any municipality of the Valencian Community, both within the application period and for the whole academic year
Students meeting the published family income and asset thresholds and the academic-progress requirements
Students who do not already hold, or are not legally able to obtain, a degree of the same or higher level
final_year_condition: Not applicable. This is an enrolled-student grant, not an admission award, so there is no secondary-school-completion route. First-year bachelor's students are eligible but must be enrolled in 2025-2026 and meet the enrolled-credit requirement (36 credits full-time, 24 part-time).
equivalent_degree_note: Yes. Foreign qualifications are accepted for the academic documentary requirements: students coming from another university or another set of studies must meet the credit-progress percentages, and students whose family was not registered in Spain during 2024 may instead submit the family record book or an equivalent official document from their country of origin. Applicants who did not pay tax in Spain in 2024 must submit tax declarations and official income certificates issued in their country of origin, plus an official certificate of any scholarships received in 2024.
previous_award_restriction: The grant is incompatible with other public or private aid with the same object, in particular the MEC general scholarship and the Conselleria d'Educació, Universitats i Ocupació university-studies scholarships for the same academic year, and with total tuition exemptions. A student who is enrolled in more than one qualifying degree may only benefit for the degree with the fewest credits pending, and cannot get this grant for any of the simultaneously studied degrees if another scholarship or aid has been obtained for one of them.

eligibility.citizenship: Must be Spanish or a national of an EU member state (base 2.2 d). Non-EU foreigners must prove administrative residence in Spain and are excluded if they are in a 'estada' (stay) situation; applicants with refugee status or subsidiary protection may obtain the legal residence permit up to 31 August 2025.
eligibility.residence_requirement: Administrative residence must be proved by an empadronament (registration) in any municipality of the Valencian Community, submitted within the application period and maintained for the whole academic year.
eligibility.age_limit: No age limit is set in the call.
eligibility.secondary_school_requirement: Not applicable. There is no secondary-school (PAU/EvAU/Bachillerato) admission-score requirement, because the applicant must already be matriculated. First-year students are expressly not required to have a minimum university-access grade.
eligibility.academic_requirements: Bachelor's: at least 36 credits in the 2025-2026 enrolment at full time, or 24 at part time. From second year onwards, students must have passed a branch-specific share of credits enrolled in 2024-2025: Arts and Humanities 70%, Sciences 50%, Social and Legal Sciences 65%, Health Sciences 60%, Engineering and Architecture 50%. For double degrees in different branches, the least demanding branch applies.
eligibility.gpa_requirement: No minimum access or average grade is set for first-year bachelor's students. Students coming from other universities or other studies must satisfy the credit-progress percentages.
eligibility.language_requirement: None. No language test or certification is required by the call. Documents not drafted in an official language of the Valencian Community must be officially translated into one.
eligibility.financial_need: Yes. Family income (tax year 2024) must not exceed EUR 22,602 (1 member), 35,731 (2), 47,033 (3), 55,332 (4), 59,928 (5), 63,960 (6), 67,902 (7) and 71,790 (8), plus EUR 3,964 per additional member. Asset thresholds also apply: the sum of cadastral values of urban properties (excluding the habitual residence) must not exceed EUR 45,900, with a parallel rule for constructions on rural land.
eligibility.previous_scholarship_restriction: See previous_award_restriction: incompatible with the MEC general scholarship, the Valencian Conselleria university scholarships, any other aid with the same object, and total tuition exemptions.
eligibility.enrolment_status_requirement: Must be enrolled in the 2025-2026 academic year at a UV own centre on an official degree. Doctoral students, títols propis students and students at affiliated centres are excluded.
eligibility.health_requirement: No health requirement for the grant itself. A legally recognised disability of 33% or more gives a EUR 1,911 deduction per affected family member (EUR 2,981 for 65% or more).
eligibility.field_restrictions: No field-of-study restrictions. The only restrictions are by type of study: official bachelor's or official master's at UV's own centres.
eligibility.official_source: Resolution of 24 March 2026 of the Head of the Vicerectorat d'Estudis de la Universitat de València, Annex I bases 1-9 (https://www.uv.es/postgrau/beques/convocatoria-ayudas-uv-2025_26_val.pdf)

academic_requirements.fixed_percentage_requirement: Branch-specific percentages of credits passed in the previous year (from second year onwards).
academic_requirements.percentage_note: Bachelor's students from second year onwards must have passed 70% (Arts and Humanities), 50% (Sciences), 65% (Social and Legal Sciences), 60% (Health Sciences) or 50% (Engineering and Architecture) of the credits enrolled in 2024-2025. These percentages also apply to part-time students. For double degrees spanning two branches, the least demanding branch applies. The credit minimum and performance thresholds may be waived for students claiming an exceptional circumstance arising in 2025.
academic_requirements.programme_specific_requirements: Enrolled-credit minimum is programme-dependent: 36 credits full-time and 24 part-time for bachelor's; 30 credits for official master's. The minimum does not apply where fewer credits remain to finish the degree or where UV's own rules prevent enrolling in the minimum.
selection_factors_may_include: Family income level relative to the published thresholds
Family asset level relative to the published thresholds
Enrolled credits and academic progress in the previous year
Whether the student already holds another scholarship or a total tuition exemption
For applicants from another university: the academic record with the average grade
academic_requirements.holistic_selection_note: Selection is threshold-based rather than merit-ranked. Where the total amount of aid proposed exceeds the available budget, base 10.4 allows the family income thresholds of Royal Decree 163/2025 to be used as the tie-breaker, in ascending order (threshold 1 to 3), preferring lower incomes, and the committee may also prorate amounts among eligible candidates so as to benefit the largest number of applicants.

english_requirement.moi_rule: No medium-of-instruction or language-of-study test is required by this call.
english_requirement.test_score_note: This call sets no language requirement of any kind. Language competence is a condition of admission to the degree, not of this aid.

language_of_instruction.language_note: The language of instruction is set by each UV official degree, not by this aid scheme. The call itself is published in Valencian and Spanish and requires documents to be in, or officially translated into, one of those two official languages of the Valencian Community.

application_method.application_route: Online only, through the Seu Electrònica UV (ENTREU) at entreu.uv.es, under 'Sol·licituds estudiants'. Paper/postal applications are not admitted (base 9.2).
application_steps: Be matriculated in the 2025-2026 academic year on an official degree at a UV own centre.
Identify yourself on the Seu Electrònica UV (ENTREU) with any accepted electronic signature system and complete the application form with the basic and call-specific data.

Attach the mandatory documentation listed in base 9.7 (family registration certificate for 2024, empadronament with 2025 information, bank details, and, for foreign applicants who did not pay tax in Spain in 2024, tax certificates from the country of origin).
Complete the electronic registration and save the PDF copy of the application, which carries a reference number and a digital summary.
Wait for the administrative instruction by the Servei d'Estudiants; if formal defects are detected, 10 working days are allowed to remedy them.
Follow the publication of the award resolution on the Tauler Oficial d'Anuncis de la Universitat de València.
Provide a bank account for payment; the grant is conditional on being up to date with the 2025-2026 tuition fees.
application_method.application_fee: None. No application or submission fee is published.

universal_documents: Certificat d'empadronament i convivència for 2024 listing all members of the family unit
Certificat d'empadronament i convivència with 2025 information, to prove administrative residence in the Valencian Community
Photocopy of the bank account details (current account or savings passbook)
Completed online application form on the Seu Electrònica UV (ENTREU)
commonly_requested_documents: Tax declaration or IRPF imputation certificate for tax year 2024 for the applicant or family members
Separation ruling / regulatory agreement or proof of single-parent or non-cohabiting family
Spanish large-family (família nombrosa) certificate issued by an autonomous community
Disability certificate issued by an autonomous community
Proof of effective family-economic independence for 2024, including domicile title or lease
Property-tax receipts for 2024 (excluding the habitual residence) and a bank certificate of interest and dividends, if the cadastral data consultation is not authorised
Court ruling for gender-based violence, SEPE/INSS unemployment or cessation-of-activity certificate, or pension-status certificate, for exceptional circumstances arising in 2025

For non-Spanish applicants who did not pay tax in Spain in 2024: tax declaration and official income certificates from the country of origin, plus an official certificate of scholarships received in 2024
For non-EU applicants: the residence permit
official_application_documents.document_language: Documents must be in one of the official languages of the Valencian Community (Valencian or Spanish), or officially translated into one of them (base 9.7).
official_application_documents.document_format: Electronic, attached to the online application on the Seu Electrònica UV (ENTREU).
official_application_documents.transcript_requirement: Required only for students who took their last university course at a university other than Universitat de València: the enrolment of the last course and a certificate of the academic record showing the average grade.
official_application_documents.certified_translation_requirement: Yes. Documents not drafted in an official language of the Valencian Community must be officially translated into one.

identity_documents.document: Certificat d'empadronament i convivència with 2025 information (also proves administrative residence in the Valencian Community)
identity_documents.notes: Must be submitted within the application period and kept for the whole academic year.
Additional requirement for non-EU foreign applicants

identity_documents.document: Family record book or equivalent official document from the country of origin (only if the applicant was not registered in Spain during 2024)
identity_documents.notes: Alternative to the 2024 Spanish registration certificate

academic_documents.document: Certificate of enrolment and academic record with average grade for the last course (only if taken at another university)

financial_documents.document: Certificat d'empadronament i convivència for 2024 with all family-unit members
financial_documents.notes: Used to verify the economic requirements

financial_documents.document: Tax declaration for 2024, or IRPF imputation certificate / paying-entity income certificate
financial_documents.notes: Required unless consent to data interchange with the Tax Agency is given and the 2024 return was filed in Spain

financial_documents.document: Official income tax certificates and scholarship certificate from the country of origin (for 2024)
financial_documents.notes: Non-Spanish applicants who did not pay tax in Spain in 2024

financial_documents.document: Property-tax receipts for 2024 and bank certificate of interest/dividends
financial_documents.notes: Only if the cadastral-data consent is not given

financial_documents.document: Large-family or disability certificates; single-parent / separation documents
financial_documents.notes: Needed to claim the corresponding deductions

additional_documents.document: Medical certificates, violence complaint/report, death certificate, SEPE/INSS unemployment certificate or pension-status certificate
additional_documents.notes: Only for exceptional circumstances arising in 2025, which may waive credit and academic-performance limits

required_documents: Completed online application on the Seu Electrònica UV (ENTREU) with electronic signature
Certificat d'empadronament i convivència for 2024 listing all computable family members
Certificat d'empadronament i convivència with 2025 information proving administrative residence in the Valencian Community
Photocopy of bank account or savings passbook details
Tax year 2024 return / IRPF imputation certificate or income certificate for each family member with income (unless data interchange is authorised and the return was filed in Spain)
Family record book or equivalent foreign document, if not registered in Spain during 2024
Tax declaration, official income certificates and scholarship certificate from the country of origin, for non-Spanish applicants who did not pay tax in Spain in 2024
Last-course enrolment certificate and academic record with average grade, for students coming from another university
Official translation of any document not drafted in Valencian or Spanish

selection_process.decision_maker: The Head of the Vicerectorat d'Estudis of the Universitat de València, on the proposal of the 'comissió de selecció de becaris' constituted under article 50 of the MEC general-grants call
selection_process.selection_type: Competitive concurrency (règim de concurrència competitiva) under article 22 of Law 38/2003, but threshold-based rather than merit-ranked
possible_stages: Online submission via Seu Electrònica UV (ENTREU) with mandatory documentation
Administrative instruction by the Servei d'Estudiants (Student Service)
10 working days to remedy formal defects or missing documents
Assessment and award proposal by the scholarship-holder selection committee
Resolution by the Head of the Vicerectorat d'Estudis
Publication of the resolution on the Tauler Oficial d'Anuncis de la Universitat de València, which serves as notification
Payment to the bank account supplied in ENTREU, conditional on tuition fees being up to date
Appeal: motion for reconsideration within one month or administrative-court appeal within two months
selection_process.official_universal_weighting: None published. The call contains no scoring or weighting formula.
selection_process.weighting_note: Award depends on meeting published income, asset, enrolled-credit and academic-progress requirements. Only when the proposed total exceeds the budget does base 10.4 apply the Royal Decree 163/2025 income thresholds in ascending order (threshold 1 to 3), preferring lower incomes, with possible prorating among eligible candidates.
selection_process.results_timing: No fixed date is published. For reference, in the preceding cycle the resolution was signed on 17 November 2025 for a call whose window had run from 26 May to 25 June 2025.
selection_process.scholarship_rank_note: There is no published ranked waiting list; the evaluation committee issues an award proposal, and the final resolution lists awarded and denied applicants in annexes.

additional_factors: Family income against the published thresholds
Family assets against the published thresholds
Enrolled-credit minimum and academic progress in the previous year
Not already being funded for the same purpose by another body
Lower income as a tie-breaker if the budget is oversubscribed
selection_criteria.source: Resolution of 24 March 2026, Annex I bases 3, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10

degree_outcome.awarded_qualification: The grant funds an official Spanish Grado (bachelor's) degree at Universitat de València; it does not itself award a separate qualification.
degree_outcome.typical_programme_length: Set by each official degree's study plan (typically 240 ECTS), not by this grant; the grant covers a single academic year.
possible_awards: Ajuda a l'estudi - payment of academic fees for one academic year
Ajuda complementària of up to EUR 1,000 - present in the 2024-2025 call (base 1.2) but NOT included in the 2025-2026 call
degree_outcome.degree_note: This is not an admission scholarship. The student must already hold a place and be matriculated on the official degree at UV.
degree_outcome.credit_transfer: Not addressed by the call. However, special prices arising from recognition or adaptation of studies are excluded from the amount of the help.

student_rights_and_cost_protection.tuition_fee_for_recipients: Academic fees (taxes acadèmiques) are paid by UV for one academic year, within the stated credit and price limits.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.student_agreement: By registering the application in ENTREU, the applicant (and their parents or guardian, where applicable) declare that they accept the bases, that the data provided are true, that they know the grant is incompatible with other similar aid, that they do not fall under articles 13 and 34.5 of Law 38/2003, and that they authorise UV to obtain academic, income and asset data from public administrations.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.common_services: UV also runs separate schemes - extraordinary DANA aid, travel grants, research collaboration, external curricular internships, temporary computer loans and Ajudes Juan Romero - which are not part of this call.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.bond_requirement: None. No service, employment or return-to-country bond is published.
student_rights_and_cost_protection.bond_breach_consequence: Not applicable. The call instead states that any non-compliance detected after award may lead to a request for repayment of the grant amount, and that inaccurate data results in automatic denial.

application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you are matriculated on an official Grado (or double Grado) at a UV own centre in the relevant academic year - not a títol propi, not an affiliated centre
Confirm your nationality/residence status: Spanish or EU national, or non-EU with administrative residence (not 'estada')
Get or refresh your empadronament in a Valencian Community municipality covering the required year
Gather the family unit's income documents for the reference tax year (2024 for the 2025-26 call) and get them officially translated if needed
Check your family income against the published thresholds (EUR 22,602 for a 1-member family up to EUR 71,790 for 8, plus EUR 3,964 per extra member)
Check your credits enrolled against the 36 (full-time) / 24 (part-time) minimum
Check the percentage of credits you passed last year against your branch requirement
Confirm you are not holding a MEC or Conselleria grant or a total tuition exemption
Prepare to apply online via ENTREU in the month after the DOGV extract is published
programme_comparison_fields: Whether the scheme is need-tested or merit-based
Whether it is an admission award or an enrolled-student award
Annual budget and number of recipients
practical_application_data.motivation_letter_strategy: Not applicable - the call requires no motivation letter, essay, interview or portfolio. Effort should go instead into the family income and asset documentation and the empadronament.
profile_fit_labels: EU student at UV needing fee relief
Enrolled bachelor's student with financial need
Accessibility / inclusion funding seeker at UV
Cannot fund tuition without fee coverage
common_mistakes: Treating it as a scholarship you can apply for before being admitted to UV - it requires current enrolment
Assuming non-EU students on a student/visitor stay status qualify - they are excluded
Applying while holding the MEC general scholarship or a Conselleria university scholarship for the same year, which makes the grant incompatible
Missing that administrative fees (expedient, card, insurance) are not covered
Expecting a fixed cash amount - the award equals your own tuition bill
Relying on a fixed calendar date for the deadline - the window is legally defined from the DOGV publication of the extract
Forgetting that the empadronament must be maintained for the whole academic year

risk_flags.risk: The scheme is not an international-admission scholarship
risk_flags.impact: Prospective applicants who have not yet been admitted to UV cannot apply, and no separate 'international' quota or merit premium exists
risk_flags.mitigation: Present it clearly as an enrolled-student fee-coverage grant; direct applicants to UV's separate travel, research and DANA aid schemes and to the national MEC and Generalitat calls for pre-enrolment options

risk_flags.impact: No application can be made for this cycle at all
risk_flags.mitigation: State the next expected cycle as spring 2027 and monitor the UV grants news page and the DOGV extract

risk_flags.risk: Deadline is defined by DOGV publication, not a fixed calendar date
risk_flags.impact: Applicants cannot plan around a stable date
risk_flags.mitigation: Record the legal rule in official_rule and set deadline_precision to typical_window with deadline_date null

risk_flags.impact: Third-country nationals without administrative residence, and non-EU nationals in 'estada' status, are excluded
risk_flags.mitigation: State the gate explicitly in citizenship_restriction and eligible_applicants so it is not overstated as worldwide eligibility

risk_flags.impact: Legally resident students registered in another Spanish autonomous community are ineligible
risk_flags.mitigation: Flag the residence requirement prominently in eligibility and in not_best_fit

risk_flags.risk: Amount is not fixed and is fee-linked
risk_flags.impact: Publishing a single 'award value' would be misleading; the benefit is the student's own tuition bill
risk_flags.mitigation: Set monthly_amount to null, describe the EUR 300,000 aggregate budget (EUR 180,000 for bachelor's) and avoid any per-head total value

risk_flags.risk: Incompatibility with the main competing awards
risk_flags.impact: Applicants holding or expecting a MEC or Conselleria scholarship for the same year cannot benefit
risk_flags.mitigation: Record the incompatibility in coverage_limitations, eligibility.previous_scholarship_restriction and risk flags

risk_flags.risk: Source language is Valencian/Spanish and the call text is long
risk_flags.impact: Non-Spanish-speaking applicants may miss conditions; the English page is a partial translation
risk_flags.mitigation: Cite the definitive Valencian call PDF as the authoritative source and note that documents must be officially translated into an official language of the Valencian Community

Application window open (one month, online via ENTREU)
Administrative instruction by the Servei d'Estudiants
Evaluation and award proposal by the scholarship-holder selection committee

database_notes: TARGET ADAPTATION: the assigned target was a University of Valencia international-undergraduate merit tuition-waiver / merit call. Research on uv.es established that UV does NOT operate a separate merit tuition-waiver call for incoming international undergraduates: all fee relief for bachelor's students at UV's own centres runs through this single needs-tested 'Ajudes a l'estudi' scheme, which requires existing enrolment, and UV's other funded awards (Bourses de viatge, research collaboration, DANA extraordinary aid, Ajudes Juan Romero) are not tuition-waiver calls for new international undergraduates. One scheme per slot was therefore recorded, and the University's flagship official study-grant / tuition-coverage call was chosen because it is the only official, fully documented, recurring, bachelor's-eligible UV funding scheme.
The scheme is means-tested, not merit-based: academic factors act as eligibility thresholds plus a tie-breaker when the budget is oversubscribed. It must not be presented as a merit award.
This is NOT an admission scholarship. Base 2.2 requires the student to be matriculated in the relevant academic year, so prospective applicants cannot apply before admission.

Citizenship gate: base 2.2 d) requires Spanish or EU nationality, or, for third-country nationals, accreditation of administrative residence in Spain; applicants in an 'estada' (stay) situation are expressly excluded. The related Valencian Empadronament requirement (base 2.2 e) additionally restricts the scheme to students registered in the Valencian Community.
worldwide_eligibility is set to false and citizenship_restriction to true for these reasons, even though the scheme funds studies at a Spanish public university.

bachelor_requirement is set to false because no prior bachelor's degree is required - the award funds a first official degree, and holding a degree of the same or higher level is actually a ground for exclusion (base 2.2 b).

deadline_date is null with deadline_precision 'typical_window': the call legally sets only 'one month from the day after publication of the extract in the DOGV', so the 10 April - 11 May 2026 window is a derived date that cannot be projected forward. The window actually used by the 2025-2026 cycle is recorded in application_period.

status is CLOSED because the 2025-2026 window closed on 11 May 2026, before the research date of 2026-10-03, while status_note carries the expectation of an annual re-call (documented for 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26).

The 'Ajuda complementària' of up to EUR 1,000 (base 1.2) appears in the 2024-2025 call and its award resolution but is absent from the 2025-2026 call, so it is listed in possible_awards with an explicit caveat rather than as current benefit.

The award-resolution PDF dated 17 November 2025 that is still linked from the current page resolves the 2024-2025 cycle, not 2025-2026; only the 2024-2025 annex amounts (observed range EUR 0 - EUR 2,120.40) were available for reading, so they are reported as context and not as the current cycle's values.
Degree-length and ECTS figures are deliberately generic because the call does not fix programme length; each official Grado sets its own study plan.
